title: From sunrise to sunset…A full day of light in a few seconds.
description:
The sun quietly travels across the sky while the world below keeps moving, growing, and breathing.
What takes an entire day for nature to perform, a timelapse lets us witness in moments.
It is a gentle reminder:
Time never rushes, yet everything gets done.
